# Voice Gateway API Reference

<!-- Code generated by gen-api-sdk; DO NOT EDIT. -->

RESTful JSON signaling API served by the standalone voice gateway.

## Health

| Method | Path | Description | Request | Response |
|--------|------|-------------|---------|----------|
| GET | `/health` | Returns gateway health status. |  | `HealthResp` |

## Compatibility

| Method | Path | Description | Request | Response |
|--------|------|-------------|---------|----------|
| GET | `/compat` | Returns gateway compatibility metadata. |  | `Compatibility` |

## Sessions

| Method | Path | Description | Request | Response |
|--------|------|-------------|---------|----------|
| POST | `/offer` | Creates a WebRTC voice session from an SDP offer. | `OfferReq` | `OfferResp` |
| POST | `/sessions/{sessionID}` | Closes an active voice gateway session. |  | `CloseSessionResp` |

## Errors

All errors return:

```json
{
  "error": { "code": "<CODE>", "message": "..." },
  "details": { ... }
}
```

| HTTP | Code |
|------|------|
| 400 | `BAD_REQUEST` |
| 401 | `UNAUTHORIZED` |
| 500 | `INTERNAL_ERROR` |

## Types

### HealthResp

HealthResp is returned by GET /health.

| Field | Type | Description | Required |
|-------|------|-------------|----------|
| `status` | `string` |  | yes |

### Compatibility

Compatibility is returned by GET /compat on the standalone voice gateway.

| Field | Type | Description | Required |
|-------|------|-------------|----------|
| `service` | `string` |  | yes |
| `gatewayProtocol` | `int` |  | yes |
| `serviceKinds` | `string[]` |  | yes |
| `capabilities` | `string[]` |  | yes |

### ServiceAuthorization

ServiceAuthorization authorizes one service-bound voice session.

| Field | Type | Description | Required |
|-------|------|-------------|----------|
| `kind` | `string` |  | yes |
| `instanceID` | `string` |  | yes |

### OfferReq

OfferReq starts a voice gateway WebRTC signaling session.

| Field | Type | Description | Required |
|-------|------|-------------|----------|
| `protocolVersion` | `int` |  | yes |
| `sdp` | `string` |  | yes |
| `service` | `ServiceAuthorization` |  | yes |

### OfferResp

OfferResp returns the WebRTC SDP answer and gateway session ID.

| Field | Type | Description | Required |
|-------|------|-------------|----------|
| `sdp` | `string` |  | yes |
| `sessionID` | `string` |  | yes |
